decision: Keep the numerically validated component as an experiment. The shared candidate saves18.2931 ms at q7169 and20.8277 ms at the declared q8192 extension in complete-component medians; this small component gain does not justify product integration while real q8192 TTFT remains about30 seconds. The global transport regresses substantially. Product dispatch and packaged providers remain unchanged; pursue a larger measured wall next.
scope: Each measured PV interval includes the parallel producer, ordered reduction, candidate collection and canonical exact replay. Common Q/K preparation, QK/probabilities and V transpose are added for the complete component comparison. Allocation, sentinel initialization, validation and warmups are outside those intervals but inside the recorded guarded process wall. Each variant has one warmup and three measured attempts per slab in rotating three-variant order, with every output checked. Original7169 rows compare directly against the frozen GB10 BF16 context; the8192 extension repeats1023 operand rows and checks appended rows against full canonical GPU replay. No extension is represented as an actual model prompt, and no model or retained-performance acceptance follows.
